native_readback.ram_layout: SRAM1 48KiB and SRAM2 16KiB contiguous alias; other alias not allocated
native_readback.scope: Native Cortex-M4 target build, vector and memory integrity only

interfaces.clock_note: HSI16, no PLL, VCORE range 1, 0 FLASH wait states; no radio clock
interfaces.events: TIM2 update interrupt 1 kHz as the time base; one duty-cycled burst every 1800000 ms (48 events/day, our assumption); ADC conversions are software-triggered inside the burst with a 2 ms bounded timeout
interfaces.frame: 12 bytes: 0xA5 header, uint8 seq, 3x uint16 big-endian raw, uint8 flags, uint8 reserved, CRC16-CCITT (poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF) big-endian
interfaces.load_source: reserve-gate PGOOD input (published 2.0 V / 3.0 V thresholds); the storage element value is unpublished
interfaces.note: target identity and vendor sources are fixed by the executor; the host run of the same core is not a board measurement, and radio/sensor/power behaviour is NOT verified

pins.PB0: PGOOD digital input from the storage-gate comparator, pull-down - assumed
pins.note: the paper publishes no pin map; this is an explicit design assumption

interfaces.polarity: storage gate PGOOD high = storage above 3.0 V; the comparator's 2.0 V / 3.0 V hysteresis is outside this MCU

unimplemented_interfaces.radio: returns ISPET_HAL_RADIO_UNIMPLEMENTED; the BLE chip/module is not published
unimplemented_interfaces.sensing_front_end: returns ISPET_HAL_AFE_UNIMPLEMENTED; electrodes/amplifier/reference buffer/filter are not published

interfaces.frame: tag local frame, +X = tunnel length, +Z = cover side, -Y = ear/pig-head side
interfaces.note: assembly.step is a multi-solid STEP written into the project working directory; it is parametric CAD, not a manufacturing drawing

native_readback.scope: Solver output integrity only; no circuit acceptance or calibration.

interfaces.initial_conditions: .ic V(7)=2.0 V(42)=2.0 V(50)=0 V(150)=0 - both branches start at the 2.0 V gate floor

node_map.1/20/2: TENG equivalent terminals and 2CL72 bridge AC input
node_map.12: gated system load branch A (0.66 mW level, 9.5 kOhm at 3 V)
node_map.13: 12.1 mW peak-burst branch (516 Ohm, 20 ms pulse)
node_map.3: rectified high-voltage node (C1 100 pF, P6KE440A clamp)
node_map.42: storage node B: same cell, 10x lower standby (3 MOhm) [sensitivity]
node_map.5/6: SCR-triggered step-down node (L1 1 mH, C2, MUR460)
node_map.50: reserve-gate latch state, node 7 branch (3.0 V set / 2.0 V reset)
node_map.7: storage node A: 470 uF, implied 10 uA standby (300 kOhm) [assumed]

interfaces.note: bounded local equivalent of the harvest-storage-gate-load stage only; two branches expose the effect of the unpublished standby current
